Design system

Light mode only. Font: DM Sans. Brand colour #016893. These values come from the app code (lib/core/design).

Colours

primary#016893Brand colour, buttons, active tab
deep#01425ADark blue: splash, duty card
deepRaised#0C5C7BRaised areas on deep blue
primaryTint#E6F2F7Light blue fill
sky#7DD3FCAccent on deep blue
skyText#A9CCDASmall text on deep blue
ink#0F172AMain text
text2#536276Second text
text3#94A3B8Hints
line#E2E8F0Lines
disabled#EEF2F6Disabled
surface#F2F5F8Page background

slate#1E293BDark buttons

successText#15803DPresent (text)

dangerDot#DC2626Absent (dot)

Spacing, radius, sizes

xs 4px
sm 8px
md 12px
lg 16px
xl 24px
xxl 32px
  • Corner radius: pill 999, large 24, medium 16.
  • Control height 56, tap target 48, small button 38, bottom bar 64.
  • Screens are designed at 390 px wide and also checked at 360 and 430.
  • The phone's text-size setting is ignored.

The design system page, as drawn in Claude Design

Admin screens

The admin side: dashboard, live map, requests, team, reports and account. Each card shows the screen, its route in the app and where its buttons go.

1 · Daily operations

Dashboard

/admin

Today at a glance: people on duty, visits, km, the four attention tiles and the latest notifications.

Buttons

  • Bell → Notifications
  • Avatar → My account
  • On-duty card → Live map
  • Requests tile → Requests tab
  • No location tile → Live map
  • Not started and On leave tiles → Team tab
  • A notification → its request, or the notification centre
  • Previous page, Next page → page through recent notifications
  • Open notification centre → Notifications
  • Bottom bar → Home, Live, Requests, Team, Reports

Live map

/admin/live

Everyone on duty on a map. Pins go stale after 5 minutes without a point.

Buttons

  • Open team list → team list
  • A pin → person card
  • Fit everyone on the map → zoom out to all
  • Call → phone dialler
  • View route → Day route
  • Bottom bar → the five admin tabs

Live map · person selected

/admin/live

One person selected: battery, distance, time on duty, visits and a timeline.

Buttons

  • Back to everyone → map with everyone
  • Call → phone dialler
  • Centre on person → centres the map
  • Stops → stops list
  • Full route and See full day route → Day route
  • Zoom in, Zoom out → map

Day route

/admin/days/:id

One person's one day: route, distance, hours, stops, visits and the day status.

Buttons

  • Previous day, Next day → that person's neighbouring day
  • Call → phone dialler
  • Change day status → Present, Half day, Absent, Sick leave or Casual leave
  • Full screen map → bigger map
  • Timeline and Visits tabs → switch the list
  • Back → previous screen

Notifications

/admin/notifications

Every admin notification, by day, with filters (All, Unread, Short duty, Requests).

Buttons

  • Filter chips (All, Unread, Short duty, Requests) → filter the list
  • A notification → its request, or stays here when it has none
  • Mark all as read → clears the unread dots
  • Load older → shows earlier notifications
  • Back → previous screen

Live map · team list open

/admin/live

The same map with the team list open: who is live, who has no update, who has finished.

Buttons

  • A person → person card on the map
  • Close team list → back to the map

Person selected · stops open

/admin/live

Person selected with the day's stops open, with their addresses.

Buttons

  • Close stops → back to the person card
  • See full day route → Day route

2 · Requests and team

Requests

/admin/requests

Attendance and leave requests. Waiting and Decided tabs, kind chips.

Buttons

  • A request → Request detail
  • Present, Half day, Absent, Approve, Reject → decide on the spot (Absent and Reject ask first)
  • Review → Request detail

Request detail

/admin/requests/:id

One attendance request: who, which day, worked hours, photos, the last 30 days and the decision panel.

Buttons

  • Call → phone dialler
  • Duty history → that person's Duty history
  • Previous photo, Next photo → photo carousel
  • Present, Half day, Reject, then Confirm → saves the decision
  • Add note → adds a note to the decision
  • Back → Requests

Team

/admin/users

All employees, grouped by today's state, with search and a role filter.

Buttons

  • + Add user → Create user
  • A person → Employee profile
  • Call (phone icon) → phone dialler
  • State tiles and role chips → filter the list

Edit details

/admin/users/:id/edit

Change a person's details, role and whether the account is on.

Buttons

  • Save changes → saves
  • Cancel, Close without saving → back
  • Account on switch → turns the account on or off

User added · temporary PIN

shown after Create user

The temporary PIN, shown once, to give to the new person.

Buttons

  • Copy → copies the PIN for one minute
  • Done → back to Team

Sick leave request

/admin/requests/:id

A leave request: the days asked for on a week grid, the doctor's note and the decision.

Buttons

  • Call → phone dialler
  • Duty history → that person's Duty history
  • Previous photo, Next photo → doctor's note photos
  • Approve or Reject → saves the decision
  • Add note → adds a note to the decision
  • Back → Requests

Employee profile

/admin/users/:id

One person: today, this month, their phone and account controls.

Buttons

  • Call → phone dialler
  • Live map → Live map (only if on duty today)
  • Route → Day route (only if on duty today)
  • History, Full history → Duty history
  • Edit details → Edit user
  • Release phone → frees a lost phone
  • Reset password → new temporary PIN (signs the person out everywhere)
  • Allow late duty on → one-day permit, or take it back
  • Account switch → turns the account on or off (asks first)
  • Add (email) → Edit user
  • Back → Team

Create user

/admin/users/new

Create an employee or an admin: user ID, name, phone, email, role and a temporary PIN.

Buttons

  • Role cards → Employee or Admin
  • New PIN → makes another 6-digit PIN
  • Create user → saves, then shows User added
  • Cancel → back

3 · Reports, account and building blocks

Reports

/admin/reports

Attendance totals and per-person bars for this month, last month or a custom range.

Buttons

  • Download PDF → Download PDF sheet
  • This month, Last month, Custom and Everyone → change the totals
  • Days still waiting banner → Requests
  • A person → that person's Duty history

Download PDF sheet

sheet on Reports

Choose Summary or Every day, then build the PDF on this phone.

Buttons

  • Range and Everyone → choose days and people
  • Summary or Every day → choose the layout
  • Create PDF → builds the file on this phone
  • Then share it: Save, WhatsApp, Print
  • Close → back to Reports

Duty history

/admin/users/:id/days

A person's calendar of days, coloured by status, and the selected day's details.

Buttons

  • A day → shows that day
  • View route of this day → Day route
  • Change day status → status sheet
  • Download this person's report → PDF sheet
  • Previous month, Next month → change month
  • Back → Employee profile

My account

/admin/account

The admin's own account.

Buttons

  • Change password → Change password
  • Notifications → Notifications
  • Log out → signs out
  • Back → Home

Component · bottom navigation

component

The admin bottom bar. The open tab is a white pill.

Buttons

  • Home, Live, Requests, Team, Reports

Employee screens

The employee side: sign in, home and duty, map and history, visits, requests and profile.

1 · Sign in

Splash

/

Shown while the app starts and checks the sign-in.

Buttons

  • No buttons

Sign in

/login

Sign in with user ID and password. Admins use the same screen.

Buttons

  • Sign in → Home (or Set password on the first sign-in)
  • Forgot password → Forgot password

Forgot password · enter code

/forgot-password

Enter the code emailed to you and choose a new password.

Buttons

  • Set new password → saves, then Sign in
  • Show password → shows or hides
  • Resend after the timer → sends another code
  • Back to sign in → Sign in

Choose your password (first sign-in)

/set-password

First sign-in with the admin's temporary PIN: choose your own password.

Buttons

  • Save and continue → Home
  • Show password → shows or hides
  • Not you? Log out → signs out

Change password

/profile/password

Change your password. Needs the current one.

Buttons

  • Change password → saves
  • Back → Profile

2 · Home and duty

Home · on duty

/home

Today's duty card, quick actions and today's visits.

Buttons

  • Avatar → Profile
  • Bell → Notifications
  • Duty off → confirm
  • Add visit → Add visit
  • My route → Map
  • Requests → My requests
  • A visit → Visit detail

Before duty on · permissions

opens over Home

Before duty on: allow location, notifications and battery settings.

Buttons

  • Allow (each row) → opens that phone setting
  • Start duty → turns duty on once all are done

Duty off · confirm

dialog on Home

Confirm ending duty, with hours and distance so far and the 10-hour goal.

Buttons

  • Yes, duty off → ends duty
  • Keep working → closes

Duty card · every state

Home, top card

Every state of the duty card, from before 5:00 AM to a finished day.

Buttons

  • See each card below

3 · Map, history and visits

My map

/map

Your own route today.

Buttons

  • Stops & timeline → opens the list
  • Add visit → Add visit
  • Map layers, Show my position, Zoom in, Zoom out → map controls
  • A day → Day route

History

/history

The last 90 days, by month, with totals.

Buttons

  • Previous month, Next month → change month
  • A day → Day route
  • A leave day → that leave request

Day route

/history/day/:id

One of your past days: route, stops and visits.

Buttons

  • Full screen map → bigger map
  • A visit → Visit detail
  • Back to history → History

Add visit

/home/visit/:dayId

Record a store visit: photo and store name are required, a note is optional.

Buttons

  • Take photo → camera (saves the place)
  • Use gallery → picks a photo (no place saved)
  • Retake photo, Remove photo → change the photo
  • Save visit → saves, then Home
  • Close → back
  • Open settings → phone setting (camera blocked)

Visit detail

opens from a visit

A saved visit: photo, store, time, place and note.

Buttons

  • Maps → opens the place in maps
  • View full screen → bigger photo
  • Close → back

4 · Requests, notifications and profile

My requests

/home/requests

Your attendance and leave requests and their answers.

Buttons

  • Attendance → Request attendance
  • Leave → Leave request
  • A request → Request detail

Request attendance

/home/requests/attendance

Ask the admin to count a day you worked but missed duty on.

Buttons

  • Duty on and Duty off times → what you worked
  • Take photo, From gallery → proof photo
  • Send request → sends it
  • Back → My requests

Leave request

/home/requests/leave

Ask for sick or casual leave for chosen days.

Buttons

  • Sick leave, Casual leave → leave type
  • Previous month, Next month, then tap days → pick the days
  • Attach → doctor's note (optional)
  • Send request → sends it
  • Back → My requests

Request detail

/home/requests/:id

One request: its progress, what you sent and the admin's decision.

Buttons

  • Cancel request → withdraws it while it is waiting
  • Doctor's note, Open → bigger photo
  • A day → Day route
  • Back to my requests → My requests

Notifications

/home/notifications

Notifications for your requests and duty.

Buttons

  • Filter chips → filter the list
  • A notification → its request or day
  • Mark all as read → clears the unread dots
  • Back → Home

Profile

/profile

Your details and account.

Buttons

  • Change password → Change password
  • My requests → My requests
  • Log out → signs out

Component · employee bottom navigation

component

The employee bottom bar.

Buttons

  • Home, Map, History, Profile

Component · duty card

component

The duty card on Home, here in its on-duty state.

Buttons

  • Duty on, Duty off, Request attendance → depends on the state

5 · Warnings and problems

Home · offline

/home (warning)

Home with no internet: duty keeps recording and sends later.

Buttons

  • Same buttons as Home

Home · location off

/home (warning)

Home when location is off: tracking has stopped.

Buttons

  • Turn on location → phone setting

Signed out

/signed-out

Shown when the app was signed out without you asking: the admin reset the account or released the phone, or it was used on another phone.

Buttons

  • Sign in again → Sign in
  • Not you? is a message only: tell the admin, who can reset the password and release the phone

Add visit · camera blocked

/home/visit/:dayId (warning)

Add visit when the camera is blocked.

Buttons

  • Open settings → phone setting
  • Use gallery → picks a photo

Add visit · gallery photo, no place

/home/visit/:dayId (warning)

Add visit with a gallery photo: no place is saved.

Buttons

  • Retake photo, Remove photo → change the photo
  • Save visit → saves without a place
